name: Apple & Blueberry Quaker Oats With Almond Butter & Banana
steps: For the blueberry compote, add 100g blueberries, the zest and juice of a lemon and maple syrup to a saucepan. Simmer on medium heat for 5 mins until jammy.
In a separate pan add your Apple & Blueberry Quaker Oats sachets along with the milk, simmer for 2 mins or until the milk is absorbed, stirring occasionally.
Slice the bananas and roughly chop almonds.

Distribute the Quaker Oats between bowls, swirl through a tbsp of the blueberry compote, top with the sliced banana, a drizzle of almond butter, finish with a scattering of roughly chopped almonds and the remaining fresh blueberries.

pt.name: Papas Quaker de Maçã e Mirtilo com Manteiga de Amêndoa e Banana
ingredients: 144g Saqueta Quaker Oats de Maçã e Mirtilo
steps: Para o composto de mirtilo, adicione 100g de mirtilos, a raspa e o sumo de limão e o xarope de ácer a um tacho. Cozinhe em lume médio durante 5 minutos até ficar em compota.
Num tacho separado, adicione as saquetas Quaker Oats de Maçã e Mirtilo com o leite e cozinhe durante 2 minutos ou até o leite ser absorvido, mexendo ocasionalmente.
Fatie as bananas e pique grosseiramente as amêndoas.

Distribua as papas pelas tigelas, envolva uma colher de sopa do composto de mirtilo, coloque as rodelas de banana, regue com a manteiga de amêndoa e termine com as amêndoas grosseiramente picadas e os mirtilos frescos restantes.
